unreachable: Could not reach the server. Nothing was confirmed as saved.
reviewStarted: Review started. Nothing else has changed.
sentToOwner: Sent to the owner. Awaiting the owner's decision.
summaryHint: Prepare an escalation summary draft below to fill this in, or write your own. Stick to the facts.
summaryConfirm: I have checked this summary and want to create an owner review request.
missingWarning: Some required details are missing. You can decline or ask for information, but you can't approve until the details are complete.
decisionLegend: Your decision for this request only
whatNeedToKnow: What do you need to know?
exceptionHint: Approving this is an exception to the rule, so explain why.
reasonHint: The reason is shown to the admin and kept in the history. It does not change the general policy.
handlingSaved: Handling note saved. The status hasn't changed.
handlingHint: Record what you have done so far and what happens next, for example who you called and when you will follow up. This is kept in the activity history. It doesn't change the status or the rule result.
whatDidYouDoHint: For example: “Processed the $30 refund in the payment system and emailed the parent.” Tutor Compass records your note. It did not do these things itself.
completedOutside: I completed these steps outside Tutor Compass, or I am recording that no action will be taken.
